note: George Washington State Forest campground (managed from Scenic State Park) on the west shore of Owen Lake: the sites lie along a long, narrow loop under red pines running out toward the peninsula's point, with a swimming beach and day-use area. --Claude
summary: DNR facility record read: 18 campsites (+2 walk-in), primitive, vault toilets, drinking water, lake access, managed by Scenic SP (218-571-2600); first come with same-day payment, 14-day summer limit, $17 tax included confirmed. Waterfront lakefront -> lakeview recommended (no site numbers placeable; sites under pine). Old note's horse and group sites are not in the DNR record.
flags: Waterfront: recommend lakefront -> lakeview (default down). The DNR describes the sites 'nestled under a healthy stand of red pines on the lake's western shore ... along a long, narrow loop', and 'even those away from the lake are an easy walk across the loop to the swimming beach', so some spurs are on the lake side. On imagery the loop is under pine canopy; the closest camper seen (about 47.6781,-93.3953) sits ~25-30 m from the south shore through brush and scattered trees. The DNR campground map (files.dnr.state.mn.us/maps/state_forests/cmp00024.pdf) answered 404 and the DNR campsite photo shows a site in pines with no water in view, so no site number can be placed on open ground to the water. Lakefront is not earned; a filtered view from the south-shore spurs is plausible.
The stored note's 'a few equestrian and group sites' is not in the DNR record for Owen Lake (George Washington's horse campgrounds are Togo and Stony Brook); dropped from the note.
Phone: none stored. The DNR names the managing unit Scenic State Park, 218-571-2600 (apply.py does not write phones).

Pin: stored 47.6789,-93.3930 lands among the buildings and docks on the peninsula's northeast shore (they look like cabins, not campsites); the DNR's facility point 47.67836,-93.39431 (~115 m SW) sits in the middle of the campground loop. Under 250 m; moving to the DNR point is optional but better.
Season: the DNR says state forest campgrounds are open seasonally with dates varying by campground; no dates are given for Owen Lake (season left unset).
